anomalies.description: A large group of people confronts armored vehicles on a multi-lane road; individuals are seen throwing objects, moving aggressively toward the vehicles, and some appear to be engaged in physical clashes near the center vehicle. A Colombian flag is visible among the crowd, indicating a protest context with escalating violence.

A large group of people confronts multiple armored vehicles on a multi-lane road; individuals are seen throwing objects, pushing against vehicles, and engaging in chaotic movement around the vehicles, consistent with violent unrest.
An armored vehicle (second from left) collides with another armored vehicle (center), causing it to swerve sharply and tilt, indicating a physical impact and loss of control.

A large crowd of people is engaged in violent unrest, surrounding and confronting multiple armored vehicles on a multi-lane road. Individuals are seen pushing, climbing on, and striking the vehicles; some hold sticks or poles. The vehicles maneuver erratically amid the crowd, with visible dust/smoke suggesting impact or tire friction. The scene shows sustained collective violent behavior, not a peaceful protest.

At approximately 9.5–12.0 s, one white armored vehicle (center) appears to collide with or be forcefully pushed into another armored vehicle (right), causing it to tilt sharply and rotate. The contact results in visible displacement and deformation of positioning, consistent with a vehicular collision during the riot.

Large crowd of people engaged in violent unrest, surrounding and confronting multiple armored vehicles on a multi-lane road; individuals are seen throwing objects, pushing against vehicles, and moving aggressively toward law enforcement vehicles, with visible dust/smoke suggesting use of crowd-control measures.

One white armored vehicle is visibly overturned on its side across the road, having collided or been pushed over during the confrontation; it remains stationary in that position from f6 (15.0s) through f10 (16.5s), indicating a crash event occurred within this interval.

Large crowd of people engaged in violent unrest on a multi-lane road, confronting multiple armored vehicles; individuals are seen throwing objects, advancing aggressively, and clashing with security forces near overturned or disabled vehicles.

Multiple instances of close-quarters physical combat between individuals within the crowd, including grappling, punching, and use of sticks/rods; visible in mid-to-late frames as the confrontation intensifies.

Large crowd of people engaged in violent unrest on a multi-lane road, clashing with security forces near armored vehicles; individuals are seen throwing objects, raising arms aggressively, and moving chaotically; dust/smoke increases over time indicating escalation.; Large crowd engaged in violent unrest on a multi-lane road; individuals are running, throwing objects, and confronting security forces; smoke and chaos persist throughout the sequence.

Multiple pairs of individuals engaged in close physical combat (grappling, punching, shoving) within the crowd, visible in mid-frames where individuals are locked together and limbs are extended in aggressive contact.

A white vehicle appears to be overturned or heavily damaged on the far left at t=28.0, with debris and dust; by t=28.5 it is obscured but initial impact is visible. Not clearly a collision with another vehicle, but abnormal vehicle state suggesting crash or rollover.
Sudden bright orange fireball erupts near a white armored vehicle on the left side of the road, consistent with an explosion (not sustained fire); visible in frames f3–f5.

A bright orange flash and rapidly expanding plume of smoke/dust emanating from near the armored vehicle at the start of the sequence, consistent with a small explosion or detonation (e.g., grenade or incendiary device).

Large crowd engaged in violent unrest on a multi-lane road, with dense smoke/dust, apparent projectiles or debris in air, and chaotic movement; an armored vehicle is present and appears to be under attack or deploying countermeasures (e.g., tear gas or water cannon), consistent with riot conditions.

A large crowd is engaged in violent unrest on a multi-lane road, with visible confrontation between protesters and a military armored vehicle that is actively deploying water cannons or tear gas (indicated by dense spray/mist across the scene). Protesters are densely packed, some holding flags (including a Venezuelan flag), and appear to be resisting or retreating under pressure. The sustained intensity, use of crowd-control weaponry, and chaotic movement indicate collective violent unrest rather than a peaceful demonstration.

Large crowd of people engaged in collective unrest on a multi-lane road, with law enforcement vehicles (including water cannon trucks) actively deploying water jets toward the crowd; smoke or mist visible near vehicles, indicating use of crowd-control measures.

A sudden plume of white smoke/steam erupts near the center-right of the road, adjacent to a white vehicle, consistent with a small explosion or canister discharge (e.g., tear gas or flashbang); not sustained fire or vehicle crash.
